[b]The Chamber of the Peoples:  March 5th, 2025[/b]

 The chamber reconvened two hours later following its recess in the morning, Consantin, having met with Severen and then various members of his own party had tossed around the idea of the coalition, the party members had determined to accept Severens offer, which had been communicated to Severen merely a few moments before the chamber reconvened.

Consantin made his way once again to his seat, greeting his allies and those even his enemies who made cordial remarks as he passed by. His mind had become greatly troubled as a whisper had been heard while he was in his office that his mother had been seen in the basilica, dressed in black and with a veil.  If this made its way to the fullness of the legislature, that his mother had appeared before a crucial vote, then not only would the vote become contentious, the very stability of the coalition between the Presidential Party and the Party for Justice would be threatened. 

Nevertheless despite these troubling thoughts he sat down and prepared to vote.

This chamber will come to order, for daily session number two! called the prelate as the loud chatter of the representatives lowered to a low murmur. 

In accordance with the rules of the chamber, the doors shall be barred, and all guests shall leave the upper chamber, save those who are granted permission as witnesses of the vote, stated the prelate. Now, let us continue, the vote for today is whether this chamber will assemble a committee to investigate the speaker of the senate, we shall count the votes, how many nay! 

There were 32 Nays.

How many Yea? called the prelate.

There were 11 Yea. 

Very well the motion to investigate the speaker is defeated 32-15, stated the prelate as the chamber rose up in a mixture of uproar and cheers. Consantin breathed a deep sigh of relief as his fathers legacy seemed to be stabilised.
